question.text: Which THREE benchmarking agencies have been appointed by the Indian Private Equity and Venture Capital Association (IVCA) to publish AIF benchmarks in INR and USD terms, per Section 10.8.1 of the Chapter?

answer.text: Fitch, S&P Dow Jones Indices, and FTSE Russell.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 249, IVCA has appointed three benchmarking agencies — CRISIL, NSE, and Preqin — to publish AIF benchmarks in INR and USD terms. Pages 247-248 support the broader benchmarking framework and reporting context. The Trap: Option B lists global private-market data providers that are not IVCA-appointed agencies. Option C names credit-rating agencies, which are unrelated to AIF benchmarking. Option D names international index providers, which are also outside the IVCA-appointed list. Note: The IVCA framework specifically appoints the three named agencies for AIF benchmark publication in INR and USD terms; other global databases may track Indian AIFs but are not part of this IVCA list.
